title: Bodycam
notes: I played Highball for roughly 15 minutes. The game asks for UE Dependencies installation at each launch; agreeing to every prompt—even those labeled for uninstalling—allows the game to run correctly. Performance reaches about 40–50 fps on the training ground, but online play drops to around 30 fps with all settings low and TSR Quality, using half the MacBook’s native resolution. It is playable on a base m5 if you really want, but as a first-person shooter it will not be optimal or as good as on better hardware, though 30–40 fps is fairly impressive given the many translation layers. WARNING: Use caution when choosing any upscale method besides TSR or OFF; altering this can crash the game, reducing frame time and fps to about 5–8 and locking all the in-game menu interaction. Removing user configuration in appdata/local and reopening the game alone does not resolve the problem. Deleting the game, clearing appdata/local files, and reinstalling fixes it, but the issue may return if those graphics settings are changed again.

title: Bodycam
notes: Issue:** Bodycam stopped launching through Highball following the November 13, 2026 update introducing Easy Anti-Cheat. **Before the update:** Bodycam launched and was playable through Highball. **Current behavior:** Launching Bodycam through Steam displays the Easy Anti-Cheat error: "Failed to load the anti-cheat module." The game cannot reach its main menu. **Troubleshooting performed:** - Verified Bodycam's game files through Steam. - Repaired the existing Highball Windows environment. - Repeated the launch attempts with the same error. **Technical findings:** - Apple M4 Mac mini - Highball 0.10.26.1 - Wine Sikarugir 10.0 Revision 6 (r28) - D3DMetal renderer - Windows 10 compatibility environment - Highball logs show `EasyAntiCheat_EOS_Setup.exe` starting in experimental WoW64 mode. - The logs do not establish whether Easy Anti-Cheat successfully installed. **Request:** Please investigate whether Bodycam's newly introduced Easy Anti-Cheat can be supported through Highball or whether the game is now incompatible with macOS Wine-based environments.
